parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify that the Sentinel enum members with bare object() values fail to round-trip through pickle because the removed __reduce_ex__ is no longer defined, so unpickling calls Sentinel(new_object) and raises ValueError. Description B additionally claims a deepcopy failure on Python 3.10, while Description A says copy and deepcopy are unaffected; that difference is secondary to the shared pickling root cause at the same location.
